Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunnyvale Auto Repair Solutions offers comprehensive auto repair services, including routine maintenance, diagnostics, and bodywork. Our facility is equipped with state-of-the-art tools and machinery, ensuring high-quality service. We prioritize safety with proper lighting and clear signage throughout our premises. We do not operate 24 hours or provide emergency towing services. Additionally, we adhere to strict policies that prohibit the installation of high-performance aftermarket parts and the use of guard dogs on-site. Our coverage for non-owned vehicles and tools is kept within the specified limits to ensure risk management.

Industry-Specific Restrictions
• No 24-Hour Operations or Emergency Wrecker Services: Shops operating around the
clock or providing emergency towing are excluded due to increased risk of accidents during
off-hours and higher liability exposures.
• Limits on Non-Owned Autos and Tools: Coverage for non-owned autos and tools must
adhere to specified policy limits. For example, non-owned auto liability coverage should be
carefully reviewed to ensure it does not exceed the insured’s operational needs, mitigating
overexposure.
• Prohibition on Guard Dogs: Use of guard dogs on premises is disallowed due to potential
liability for dog bites or injuries to employees and customers.
